text: Public model-path propagation complete: ModelBuildSpec now accepts FactorLevelRegistry and EmptyCellPolicy, and FmriModelBuilder forwards both through block-formula and ordinary EventModelBuilder construction. ModelBuilderSuite covers numeric-coded conditions with declared levels 1/2/3, retained zero cell, stable declared/observed audit, and policy receipt. Evidence after this slice: modelJVM/test 20/20; modelJS/test 20/20; designJVM/test 175/175; designJS/test 175/175; fitJVM/test 172/172; fitJS/test 164/164; git diff --check clean. P2.1 remains open: cross-run/subject schema binding, richer retained/omitted cell receipts, contrast distinction for declared-empty cells, mixed-run coverage, and S08/S09 scenarios are not complete.
